Regulation: B.C. Reg. 88/2026
Made under: Workers Compensation Act
Published in: No. 10 – B.C. Regs. 83 to 93, June 2, 2026
Deposit date: May 22, 2026

B.C. Reg. 88/2026, deposited May 22, 2026, under theWORKERS COMPENSATION ACT[section 109 (3)]. Order in Council 201/2026, approved and ordered May 22, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that theWorkers Compensation Act, R.S.B.C. 2019, c. 1, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule. — J. WHITESIDE,Minister of Labour; L. BEARE,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1For each item in the following table, the provision of theWorkers Compensation Act, R.S.B.C. 2019, c. 1, listed in column 1 is amended by striking out the dollar amount shown in column 2 and substituting the dollar amount shown in column 3: Index Page|Previous Regulation|Next Regulation|Cumulative Index Page Copyright © 2026: King's Printer, Victoria, British Columbia, Canada

minutes_briefs.title: B.C. raises Workers Compensation Act dollar thresholds for 2026
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia has amended the Workers Compensation Act to update certain dollar amounts. The regulation, B.C. Reg. 88/2026, replaces specific dollar figures in the Act with new, higher amounts. This change affects the thresholds used in the workers' compensation system, which is the insurance program that covers workplace injuries and illnesses.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Review the specific dollar amounts in the Workers Compensation Act that apply to your business to ensure your records and procedures reflect the updated thresholds.

key_dates.label: B.C. Workers Compensation Act dollar amount changes take effect

minutes_briefs.industries: Labour & Employment, Construction & Development, Transportation & Logistics
